bearerAuth.description: JWT (dashboard sessions) or `furan_pat_*` (SDK/CI). Both arrive on `Authorization: Bearer ...`. A token works only until it expires (`401 token_expired`), on its bound project or its owner's member projects (`403 token_project_mismatch` / `not_a_project_member`), and on the endpoints its scope allows: `sdk` the SDK/CI endpoints, `read` their GETs (`403 insufficient_scope`). Token management, admin endpoints and `/trpc` need a session (`403 session_required`).

device.description: Device label; part of the baseline identity.

domHtml.description: Optional captured DOM HTML; powers the accessibility (axe) pass.

matchLevel.description: Match level for this checkpoint. Default `Strict`.

name.description: Checkpoint name (required in v1.1+ shape; logged for traceability).

pngBytes.description: PNG screenshot bytes. Max 50 MB. Required.

regions.description: JSON object `{ ignore, layout, floating, content, accessibility }`, each an array of `{ x, y, width, height }` boxes (floating adds `maxUpOffset`/`maxDownOffset`/`maxLeftOffset`/`maxRightOffset`, accessibility adds `type`); at most 50 per kind. Invalid JSON or shape is refused with 400 `invalid_regions`. Regions mask diffs once the checkpoint is approved.
